title: Mack used Grof's holotropic breathwork to help abductees recall their experiences

tellings.quote: then Mack would use that in his practice with a lot of the um the abductees in order for them to recall their experiences.

plain: In the 1990s, John Mack, a researcher who worked with people saying they had been taken by aliens, reportedly used a method called holotropic breathwork to help them remember what happened. Holotropic breathwork is a deep, fast breathing technique for reaching altered states, developed by a researcher named Stanislav Grof. Michels describes this himself, without naming a source.
